title: Getting Ready for a Glittering Halloween

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As the Halloween Festival draws near... The bustling streets of Landosol were steadily preparing for the festivities.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンフェスティバルが近付く頃──
ランドソルの繁華街は、祭りの準備が着々と進められていた。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, thank you for having me! 
This year too, I'll be setting up a stall next to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうもー、
お世話になりますー！
今年も隣に屋台出させてもらいますねー！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Likewise, I look forward to working with you this year!
We will also be selling cupcakes that can rival your parfait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお！　
こちらこそ、
今年もよろしくお願いします！
そちらのパフェに負けないくらい、
うちもカップケーキを売りますよー！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's what I want! Just a little more until the festival...
Let's do our best with the preparations, okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
望むところです！
お祭りまでもう少し……
準備がんばりましょうね！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text:
Let's make lots of sweet and delicious sweets! 
For the smiles of our customers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たっくさん甘くて美味しいスイーツを作りましょう！
お客さんの笑顔のために！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The smell is amazing~!
There are sweet and delicious food stalls everywhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やばばば！　
超いい匂いなんですけど～！
あっちもこっちも、
甘くておいしそーな屋台がもう出てるしー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: The preparations have just begun, but it's already bustling! Isn't it crazy that it's going to get even busier for the Halloween festival?
text_block_list.orig_text:
準備始まったばっかなのに、
けっこー賑わってんじゃん！
ハロウィンフェスに向けて、
もっと増えるってやばくね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
This year's Halloween, since I have off work too,
I'm seriously excited!
I wonder if Hidesai is free? Let's invite him on a date ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年のハロウィンは仕事もオフにしたから、
マジ楽しみー！
ヒデサイは暇かなー？　
デートに誘っちゃお♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Before that, let's go check it out!
The city's decorations have already started,
and we need to check out this year's costume trends too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その前に下見しとこーっと！　
街のデコも始まってるし、
今年の仮装のトレンド、
チェックしなきゃだし！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Pumpkins, lanterns, candy stalls!
Is this the Halloween festival?!
I've never seen it before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オオー！　
カボチャ、
ランタン、
お菓子屋台！
これがハロウィンのお祭りデスか！　
初めて見まシタ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: The idea of the dead returning from the afterlife is similar to Togoku's Obon, but the atmosphere is completely different!
text_block_list.orig_text:
死者が
あの世から戻ってくるというのは、
トーゴクのオボンに似ていマスが、
雰囲気は全然違いマスね！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
If it's during the Bon festival, it's not pumpkin but eggplant and cucumber! And if it's during the New Year,
pumpkin is considered a lucky food to eat in winter!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お盆なら、
カボチャじゃなくて
ナスとキュウリデス！
それにトーゴクなら、
カボチャは冬に食べる縁起物デス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Shogun, I would like you to take a break from unifying the land... In order to provide you with enjoyment, I, your retainer, will scout ahead for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグンには、
天下統一の息抜きをしてもらいたいデス……
お楽しみいただくために、
家来のワタシが今のうちに下見しておくデス！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, the preparations have already started~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
もう準備始まってたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... 
 I wonder what kind of food stalls there are~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれどれ～？
どんな屋台があるのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Parfait with cupcakes... and cotton candy!
Ahh, there are so many delicious things!
text_block_list.orig_text:
パフェにカップケーキ……
それにわたあめ！
あぅ～、
おいしそうなものがいっぱいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But, it seems like there isn't a food stall selling Sata Andagi Doughnuts, huh~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
やっぱサーターアンダギーの屋台はなさそうだね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ever since I left my hometown, I've only been eating homemade food, so I wanted to treat myself and buy something to eat once in a while...
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷を出てから
手作りのしか食べてないから、
たまには買って食べたかったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm satisfied because the one I made myself is delicious~
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあでも、
自分で作ったのもおいしいから満足してるけどね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'll make enough to eat and carry it with me so I can eat it anytime~ Munch munch... Mmm, it's delicious~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
食べたい分を作って、
持ち歩いていつでも食べれるしね～
モグモグ……
ん～、
おいしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Maho told me that it's okay to take a break sometimes, 
so I'm going to spread my wings to the fullest! I can't wait for Halloween to start soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホからたまには休んでいいって言われたし、
思いっきり羽を伸ばすさ～！　
早くハロウィン始まってほしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: now that I think of it, I wonder if {0} also has a day off for Halloween~? I want to play together~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
{0}も、
ハロウィンは休みかな～？
一緒に遊びたいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll try inviting you~
Munch munch...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度誘ってみるとするさ～
モグモグ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Kya wa wa!
There are already so many cute accessories lined up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃわわ！
もにカワなアクセとかもう並んでるしー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I wear? 
Oh, but I kinda want it to match with Hidesai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれ着けよっかなー？
あーでも、
どうせならヒデサイとおそろしてみたいなー

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I wonder what other things there are?
text_block_list.orig_text: 他にはどんなのがあるんだろー？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! What's with this doggy accessory!
It's so fluffy, it's seriously hilarious! It's totally cool,
like, seriously!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっはー！　
なにこの犬のアクセ！
ふわふわしててマジわろー！　
おにイケてるんですけどー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
But isn't it a bit big for an accessory? 
It's too strong of a cuteness appeal, right?
Like wearing it on your head to make it stand out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
アクセにしてはちょっとおっきくね？
かわいさのアピ、
強すぎじゃん？　
頭に乗っけて盛る的な感じ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Let me give it a try... Let's see now...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと試してみよっと……
どれどれー？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait! Huh? 
It totally ran away somewhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ちょ！　
ええー！？
どっかに逃げちゃったんですけど！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Is moving accessories a trend this year?! 
I don't know about it either!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年は動くアクセがトレンドなの！？
うちでも知らないんですけど！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Well, I haven't bought it yet, and there's no one at the store either. Isn't this bad?! Anyway, I should catch it and bring it back to the store! I have to chase after it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、
まだ買ってないし、
お店の人もいないし、
やばくね！？
とりま捕まえて、
お店に戻したほうがいいよね！　
追いかけなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Vampires and werewolves...
are these supernatural goods?
I can't believe they sell these kinds of things at a stall...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フーム……
吸血鬼に
狼男……
これは妖怪の雑貨デスか？
こういった物も屋台で売られるとは……！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's still under preparation,
Halloween is quite different from Obon... 
It's rather eerie... and quite intriguing-des!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ準備中とはいえ、
ハロウィンはオボンとはかなり違うようデスね……
なんとも面妖な……
興味深いデース！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Wait!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ってー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.orig_text: ……おや？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
That person... it seems their pet dog has escaped! 
I'll lend a hand here too! Shubba!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの人……
飼い犬が逃げてしまったみたいデスね！
ここはワタシも助太刀いたしマス！　
シュバッ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: You're too fast on your feet! Seriously, you're way too dog-like!
text_block_list.orig_text:
足速すぎっしょー！　
マジ犬っぽすぎだしー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I'll help catch them too! 
I can't overlook people in trouble! Shubababa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヘーイ！　
ワタシも捕まえるのを手伝いマス！
困ってる人は見過ごせまセン！　
シュバババっ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Seriously? Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジ？　
サンキュー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Wait for me-desu! I won't let you escape!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待つデース！　
逃しまセンよー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Did it run away over here...?
text_block_list.orig_text: こっちのほうに逃げてきたはずなんだけど……？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: I can't seem to find it...
text_block_list.orig_text: 見当たりまセンね……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I give up~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
やめるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I heard a voice from the other side of that corner! 
Let's go check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？　
あの角の先から声がしまシタ！
行ってみまショウ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's my Sata Andagi, you know~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こーら、
それ私のサーターアンダギーだよ～！

text_block_list.text: Woof woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: わんわんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I see~ So it's that delicious, huh~!
In that case, I'll give you another serving~! Here, please~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～、
そんなにおいしいんだね～！
それならおかわりあげるさ～！　
ほら、
どうぞ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Are you eating sweets...? 
Were you a real dog this whole time...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ……
スイーツ食べてるんですけど……？
もしかして本物の犬だった的な……？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that Kaori?! 
Long time no see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか、
カオりんじゃね！？
超おひさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh~! It's Suzuna, huh~! 
Seems like you're doing well, that's great~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お〜！　
スズナだね〜！
元気そうでなによりさ〜！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: More importantly, did both of you come chasing after this child?I don't know whose child it is, but they jumped at me trying to eat my Sata Andagi~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
二人ともこの子を追ってきたの～？
どこの家の子か分からないけど、
私のサーターアンダギーを食べようと飛びかかってきたんだよね〜

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, are you not one of their pets?
In any case, you're so cute! Fluffy and adorable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ムム、
お二人どちらかのペットではなかったんデスか？
なんにせよ、
かわいいデスね！　
もふもふしてマス！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I saw it at the accessory shop, so I thought it was a new accessory for sure. It's so unexpectedly surprising, I'm seriously amazed~
text_block_list.orig_text:
アクセ屋で見かけたから、
てっきり新作アクセだと思ってたんだよね。
意外すぎてマジイミフ～

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
Even though it's a stray dog, should I just leave it be? 
Should I report it somewhere?
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
野良犬とはいえ、
放っておいていいんでショウか……？
どこかに届け出たほうがいいデスか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is troublesome...
Even in our guild, things like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
困ったね～……
うちのギルドでも、
こういうことは……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hidesai?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒデサイ！？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Shogun!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ショーグン！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: {0}, what's up with that strange contraption on your back? And what do you mean by "collecting" this child?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、
なんか変な機械を背負ってどうしたさ～？
それに、
この子を回収するって、
どういうことさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori and the others
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
In a town that had begun to be colored with a Halloween atmosphere, 
a mysterious dog and {0} appeared before Kaori and the others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハロウィンムードに色づき始めた街で、
カオリたちの前に、謎の犬と{0}が現れたのだった。
